cookieconsent.paragraph: We use cookies to track visitors, measure ads, ad campaign effectiveness and analyze site traffic. We may also share information about your use of our site with 3rd parties. For more info, see our {cookiePolicyLink} and {privacyPolicyLink}. By clicking on "{managerLabel}" you can choose to enable only certain cookie categories. By clicking "{acceptAllLabel}" you agree to the storing of all cookies on your device. In case you don't choose one of these options and use our website we will treat it as if you have accepted all cookies.

footer.title: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥

footer.quote: Whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness rises, I manifest Myself. To protect the righteous, to annihilate the wicked, and to reestablish the principles of dharma, I appear millennium after millennium.

interpretations.theological_view: Avatars manifest to restore dharma when it declines (Bhagavad Gita 4.7-8).
interpretations.earth_age_comparison_note: 1 Kalpa (4.32 billion years) is surprisingly close to the modern scientific estimate of Earth's age (~4.54 billion years).
interpretations.scaling_comment: This mathematical scaling is highly structured and proportional across all cosmic levels.
